book.title: Luka Iesu Keriso Hari Manoḡa Lukaꞌa Mirihiro

content: Iradugu Ḡoeꞌa Riḡa zu Inara Ḡoeꞌa
Eꞌe madaḡano vaze ḡuḡuvaḡaniꞌa nuꞌoraro ꞌahine, nariga odaze rana edaro. Ebu Iesuꞌa ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa ibite ziro, “Zaꞌe Farisea azaḡa ḡiazoꞌi, mazaḡa zeꞌe zama guhi azaḡa ebu isiti heuḡa.
Rehano ꞌuꞌuru radiroteꞌe ḡauḡa niduꞌa fureraꞌuma, ebu ogone ḡahiniroteꞌe ḡauḡa zuni ederiꞌuma.
Eꞌanoꞌo zaꞌa uzabo zamaḡano nagini sifu reiroteꞌe ḡoeꞌaꞌe vazeꞌa mada agaḡano igiꞌuma. Ebu zaꞌe bazuni neḡa zamaḡano nagini gumude reiroteꞌe ḡoeꞌa vazeꞌa ne binuḡa hitaganonoꞌo rae fureniꞌuma.
Eḡe nego nabudi, eḡeꞌa hube hune ziꞌohe. Ahiri mauꞌeteꞌe azaḡa ago rihozoꞌi, mazaḡa zeꞌe vine sausaunogaꞌe mene idaḡa.
U za iniu rihoniteꞌe eḡeꞌa ihoziꞌuma. Aniꞌe vaze manadu ire roga radiu tuḡutuḡu zamaḡano mae feuzeꞌeteꞌe gigiꞌaḡa obone tiꞌohe. Ani rihonoꞌi. Hube hune eḡeꞌa ziꞌohe, ani daꞌo rihonoꞌi.
Tiburi niniḡa fuꞌo hadi komeꞌa
hina seroneꞌohe. Rehano Badiꞌaꞌa zeḡe boꞌaḡano tiba zuni mene aḡutu modeꞌohe.
Badiꞌaꞌa zae zamare borofadu vadinize iguḡa niduꞌa nugu zuni edeḡa. Eꞌano'o ago rihanoꞌi, mazaḡa zaꞌe Badiꞌa ubumao tiburi niniḡa ḡehaḡa ufeta vitize ḡihiꞌaḡa.
Eḡeꞌa ziꞌohe, iniuꞌa vaze ubumao eḡe moneo edaune, Vaze Ubuga zuni Badiꞌa tuḡure viga niduꞌa ubumao ani moneo edaꞌuma.
Rehano iniuꞌa vaze ubumao eḡe oꞌohine, eḡe zuni Badiꞌa tuḡure viga niduꞌa ubumao ani oꞌoniꞌuma.
Iniuꞌa Vaze Ubuga agirohauꞌenaꞌa rae sausaunine, Badiꞌaꞌa ane haḡai sauꞌa rae modiꞌuma, rehano iniuꞌa Vine Zaḡoḡa agirohauꞌenaꞌa rae sausaunine, ane haḡai sauꞌaꞌe mene rae modiꞌuma.
Eḡe uꞌano, zaꞌe kotao tutuze onamadu nu'onu'o neḡano zuhiꞌaḡazuhiꞌaḡa zu inarazeta azaḡa zamao ohozoꞌidene, nougenouge zae bare biriteꞌe ga nagini rae ḡoeriteꞌe moneo zamaze ago adudanoꞌi.
Mazaḡa eꞌe madaḡano zaeꞌa nouge rae ḡoeriteꞌe moneo Vine Zaḡoḡaniꞌa ihoziꞌuma.”
Maꞌora Vazeḡa Kauriḡa Hari Idaidaḡa
Vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa vaze ḡuḡuvaḡa boꞌaḡano Iesu niro, “Ihore vazeḡa, mamafeꞌa mode rudaroteꞌe toheḡa nu rovonadu naeḡa eḡe enoga veize negohe noꞌi.”
Iesuꞌa naenaeniro, “Nego, vazeni ꞌahoganiꞌa toheze ḡahugeꞌeteꞌe gauḡa veize e mene ohohiro.”
Ebu Iesuꞌa ziro, “Za ununu haḡaiḡa mene haḡaifine, zamaze obone giganoꞌi! Mazaḡa vazeꞌa tohe ḡehaḡaonoꞌo ḡabone mene hideꞌohe.”
Ebu hari ꞌahoga idane ziro, “Maꞌora vazeḡa ꞌahoganiꞌa mebaḡano ogomu manomano hiriviro.
Ebu ani aneꞌa bare zamariro, 'E ogomuhe godoḡo neḡaꞌe oꞌoꞌa. E nougiꞌuma?'
Ebu ani raenaꞌa, 'E ꞌahige haḡaine manoḡa! Ogomu godoḡo neḡa amahiḡaꞌe fahadu boro iziga ogoraꞌuma ebu ogomuhe zu tohehe niduꞌa eꞌea zouniꞌuma.'
Ebu ani aneꞌa bare raenaꞌa, ꞌE muri faḡa radoga veize ogomu boro hune ruhibe teha. Eꞌanoꞌo eꞌe ogauꞌenaꞌa zu gageꞌenaꞌa matuꞌe onamiꞌuma!'
Rehano Badiꞌaꞌa niro, 'Ḡaꞌe mene huhuzaḡa. Eḡeꞌa izidi ohere ḡae ḡabone mae vaḡinine, ḡa ruhibateꞌe toheḡa'e iniuꞌa meꞌuma?'”
Iesuꞌa ḡonagano ḡoeriro, “ꞌUguḡa vazeḡaꞌe ane tohe daꞌo nuꞌoneꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa, rehano Badiꞌa ubumao aniꞌe mene maꞌora vazeḡa.”
Ago Zamare Adudanoꞌi
Ebu Iesuꞌa ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa ziro, “Eꞌanoꞌo eḡeꞌa ziꞌohe, zae ḡabone veize nagi ogomu aꞌuma, ga ahirize veize nagi dabua vidaꞌuma rae ago zamare adudanoꞌi.
Mazaḡa ḡaboneꞌe ogomu vitinoga, zu ahiriꞌe dabua vitinoga.
Nugo gaoza zamaroꞌi. Ze ezone mene ḡorauꞌohe, mene hiriveꞌohe, ebu ogomu godoḡo neḡa zu oꞌoꞌa. Rehano Badiꞌaꞌa ḡubuzeꞌohe. Zaꞌe nini vitize hunoga.
Zae boꞌaḡano iniuꞌa zamare adudu radiune, ḡaboneḡaꞌe tahiḡa nu faraꞌumahe?
Zaꞌe ḡau komeꞌa ꞌahoga haḡaoga zuni mene idaḡa. Nougadu ḡau ꞌahogaꞌahoga veize zamare aduduꞌohe?

Butu kakaḡaꞌe nougenouge ḡuhureꞌeteꞌe zamaroꞌi. Ze mene gaueꞌohe ga dabuaze mene turineꞌohe. Rehano eḡeꞌa ziꞌohe, butu kakaḡa ꞌahoga zuni maꞌora vazeḡa kini Solomonaꞌa haḡairoteꞌe dabuaḡa manomano vitine hunoga.

Ebu butu veḡaꞌe izidi ḡaboga, u ohoḡoreꞌe masinadu ireo hufi haoniꞌuma. Rehano Badiꞌaꞌa dabua vidohauꞌohe. Zaꞌe ve vitinoga, eꞌanoꞌo Badiꞌaꞌa dabua manoḡa ufeta vidoziniꞌuma. Rehano zaꞌa Badiꞌa mazao fieꞌetaꞌaꞌe tahiḡa fase!
Eꞌanoꞌo zaꞌe nagini aꞌuma ga nagini gagiꞌuma rae ago ufeta zamaroꞌi, zu zamaze ago adudanoꞌi.
Mazaḡa Badiꞌa aḡuꞌa azaḡaniꞌa eꞌeguḡa niduꞌa vaḡe inareꞌohe, rehano Mozeꞌe zaeꞌa eꞌeguḡa urateꞌeteꞌe edereꞌohe.
Badiꞌaꞌa zuhiꞌazoga vaḡoꞌi, ꞌougine eꞌeguḡa niduꞌa zuni ziniꞌuma.
Mamoe komeꞌakomeꞌa, za ago rihanoꞌi, mazaḡa zae Mamaꞌa za zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe uꞌano matuꞌe rudauꞌohe.
Ebu toheze seronadu hadiḡaꞌe zahara azaḡa zenoꞌi. Zae veize mene zigatiteꞌe hadi fuseḡa haḡaoꞌi, zu mene hauḡiteꞌe toheḡa adureo nuꞌone toꞌi. Eꞌea ḡonoreꞌa mene areꞌohe ebu zuhiꞌa mene sausauneꞌohe.
Mazaḡa za ḡauze naeḡa boro nouma tine, zamaroneze zuni eꞌea tiꞌohe.”
Zuhiꞌa Boroꞌa Ariteꞌe veize Ruhiboꞌi
Iesuꞌa ziro, “Zaꞌe gau dabuaḡa haḡadu ruhibe radoꞌi, ebu ihureze agane modoꞌi.
Zuhiꞌazeꞌa hahu muiḡanonoꞌo baradu ibihetao toketokerine, ibiheta ḡarihe vavaꞌoga veize guhineꞌeteꞌe azaḡa teigoꞌi.

Zuhiꞌazeꞌa baradu ane tuḡure azaḡaniꞌa ani guhine radiuꞌeteꞌe horozine, ane tuḡure azaḡaniꞌa matuꞌe rudaꞌuma. Eḡeꞌa hube hune ziꞌohe, zuhiꞌazeꞌa gau dabuaḡa vidanadu ogauꞌeteꞌe fataḡa uhiḡano ane tuḡure azaḡa ohoziꞌuma, ebu zeḡe babaḡano edauꞌenaꞌa, ogomu ḡahugiꞌuma.
Ebu zuhiꞌazeꞌa ohere ga uzeuze feuradu tuḡure azaḡaniꞌa ani guhine radiuꞌeteꞌe horozine, ani tuḡure azaḡaniꞌa matuꞌe rudaꞌuma.
Rehano za ꞌadi zamaroꞌi. Ne vazeḡaniꞌa ḡonore vazeḡaꞌe noꞌe madaḡano ani ne aritaꞌaꞌe ederifone, ḡonore vazeḡaniꞌa mene diuḡoga veize ani neḡa faine taufifo.
Eꞌe teige, zae zuni ruhibe radoꞌi, mazaḡa Vaze Ubugaꞌe za mene edereꞌeteꞌe madaḡano ariꞌuma.”
Ebu Peteroꞌa niro, “Zuhiꞌa Boro, ḡaeꞌa hari idaidaḡa ꞌadiꞌe emeḡe daꞌo veize ga vaze niduꞌa veize zuni?”

Zuhiꞌa Boroꞌa naenaeniro, “Iniuꞌe vaze huhuzaḡa zu zamaḡa niduꞌa hina gaueꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa? Tuḡure vazeḡa ꞌahogaꞌe vaze ꞌuguḡa reine, zuhiꞌaḡaniꞌa aniꞌe tuḡure vazeḡa ḡihiꞌaḡano mae ohonadu ꞌahige niꞌuma, 'Ḡa tuḡure azaḡa niduꞌa taufoꞌi. Ogomuze zuni mada idunane zenoꞌi.'
Ebu tuḡure vazeḡa eꞌeꞌa ꞌouge gauine ebu zuhiꞌaḡaniꞌa bare feuradu horonine, tuḡure vazeḡa aꞌe matuꞌe rudaꞌuma.
Eḡeꞌa hube hune ziꞌohe, aniꞌe zuhiꞌaḡaniꞌa ane tohe niduꞌa taufeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡano ohoniꞌuma.
Rehano tuḡure vazeḡa aꞌe aneꞌa bare raenaꞌa, 'Eḡe zuhiꞌaꞌe vesuꞌu faḡanobuꞌu ariꞌuma,' rae zamaradu ohoze tuḡure azaḡa zu roḡae tuḡure azaḡa niduꞌa bouzine zu ufeta ogau gage baboraune, nougiꞌuma?
Aniꞌa mene zamareꞌeteꞌe zu mene edereꞌeteꞌe madaḡano zuhiꞌaḡaniꞌa bare aradu ane ahiri variꞌe tahitahiꞌuma, ebu zama niduꞌa hina mene gaueꞌeteꞌe azaḡa habaꞌano ohonadu aduga boro haꞌuma.
Tuḡure vazeḡaꞌe ane zuhiꞌaꞌa nagini urateꞌetaꞌaꞌe edereꞌe rehano, mene ruhibine zu mene haḡaine, aniꞌe boune sausauniꞌuma.

U tuḡure vazeḡaꞌe ane zuhiꞌa ura mene ederadu veꞌoḡa haḡaine, aniꞌe tahiḡa boune tauḡiꞌuma. Iniuꞌe Badiꞌa mazaonoꞌo ḡehaḡa hidine, Badiꞌaꞌe ani mazaonoꞌo ḡehaḡa mouga urateꞌohe. Ebu iniuꞌe Badiꞌaꞌa ane gau boro haune, Badiꞌaꞌe ani mazaonoꞌo ḡehaḡa umideꞌohe.”
Mene Uniho Manoḡa, Rehano Rovotiꞌuma
Iesuꞌa bare ziro, “Eḡeꞌa raha ꞌadi hofoga radu ire roga mae ariro. Ire rogaꞌa amahi raha ꞌadi iri radiune, e matuꞌe rudaꞌuma.
Rehano e aduga hiditeꞌe babatisoḡa meꞌuma, zu zamaheꞌe adudaꞌuma onamo ḡonaga meꞌuma.
Zaꞌe eḡeꞌa raha ꞌada uniho manoḡa mae ovairo rae zamareꞌehe? Mene. Eḡeꞌa ziꞌohe, e vaze rovoze ḡuzuhoga veize ovairo.
Izidionoꞌo onamo zama moneo eḡe uꞌano ne azaḡaꞌe rovotiꞌuma. Ne eꞌe azaḡaꞌe fuꞌo reine, zeḡe boꞌaḡano rovotadu uḡiduꞌa aheu teite agirotitiꞌuma, ga aheuꞌa uḡidu teite agirotitiꞌuma.

Moganiꞌa ubuga teite agirotitiꞌuma, ga ubuganiꞌa moga teite agirotitiꞌuma. Viꞌaniꞌa aboḡa teite agirotitiꞌuma, ga aboḡaniꞌa viꞌa teite agirotitiꞌuma. Viꞌaniꞌa ubuga inuga teite agirotitiꞌuma, ga ubuga inuganiꞌa iꞌa viꞌa teite agirotitiꞌuma.”
Madaḡa Ederoꞌi
Iesuꞌa vaze ḡuḡuvaḡa ziro, “Zaꞌe ḡozeꞌa ḡutanoga horoneꞌetene,
zogone ꞌahige raꞌohe, 'Iruguꞌa ruꞌaꞌuma.' A hube, iruguꞌa ruꞌauꞌohe.
Ebu ohere ḡozeꞌa bororanadu nahuduꞌetene,
zaꞌa raenaꞌa, 'Madaꞌa hiaꞌuma.' A hube, madaꞌa hiauꞌohe.
Zama guhi azaḡa! Zaꞌe adure zu raha iraḡa horoneꞌetene, naginiꞌa fureratitaꞌaꞌe edereꞌohe. Rehano izidi madaḡano naginiꞌa fureru radiuꞌeteꞌe moneo huga eꞌe mene edereꞌohe.
Za nougadu zaeꞌa bare naginiꞌe duduḡa rae mene edereꞌohe?

Ḡaꞌe vaze ꞌahoga hadiḡa meiroteꞌe uꞌano aniꞌa kotao ohoꞌihi radu ani teite onamoꞌidene, ibio uniho manofoga veize inare hunoꞌi. Mene ꞌougine, aniꞌa oboꞌe teadu kota vazeḡa mazao tutuꞌe onamiꞌuma, ebu hena kota vazeḡaniꞌa ḡuꞌa neḡa taufeꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa ꞌevoreo ohoꞌadu ḡuꞌa neḡano ohoꞌiꞌuma.
Eḡeꞌa ziꞌohe, za ḡuꞌa neḡanonoꞌo mene buaꞌuma, onamo zaeꞌa ani hadi niduꞌaꞌe baroniꞌuma.”
